test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An image of God used for worship.
solution:
The correct answer is **Idol.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Idol: **an image or representation of a god used as an object of worship.

 
 
• **​ Example: **The **idol **in this temple is made of red stone and is 4 feet high. 
 
 

Hence, the correct option is Idol. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ideal:** most suitable.
 
• **Logo: **a symbol or other small design adopted by an organization to identify its products, uniform, vehicles, etc.
 
• **Model: **a thing used as an example to follow or imitate.
